does: Runs when the load of a dummy made from a template has ended: attaches the dummy to the current level's scene, and for a character template whose dummy has a source character refreshes the equipment visuals and marks them as invisibility attachments.

evidence.says: It reads the scene at 0x28 of the client level manager's current level, calls code:ecl::TLPreviewDummyHelpers::AttachDummyToScene, and only when the template's type is character and the dummy's source entity (0x88) has ecl::Character goes on to the equipment.
A probe while a dialog starts shows 7 of the 27 calls of AttachDummyToScene coming from it, as many as dummies were made from templates.
